# UX v2 U7 synthetic three-stage fixture

Every log in this directory is generated for local validation. These are not
Gaussian program outputs and do not represent a chemical reaction. The same
small B/H geometry is repeated so the structure route can verify that boron is
shown as `B`; the three deliberately nonzero Gibbs totals exercise the path
shape and zero-point calculation only.

Expected Gibbs totals are R = -10.000 Eh, TS = -9.980 Eh, and P = -10.020 Eh.
With R as the zero point, expected relative energies are 0, +0.020, and
-0.020 Eh (approximately 0, +12.550, and -12.550 kcal/mol).
